weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 今天，你的伴侶可能會分享一些令人興奮的職業消息，並想帶你去慶祝一下，白羊座。優先考慮去，即使這意味著要重新安排你的計劃。你的朋友散發著積極的氣息，看起來很漂亮，並且散發著熱情的能量。如果您想度過一個難忘的夜晚，請抓住這個機會。並且不要忘記在外表方面展現出最好的一面！
aries.horoscope_en: Today, your partner might share some exciting career news and want to whisk you away for a celebration, Aries. Make it a priority to go, even if it means rearranging your plans. Your friend is radiating positivity, looking fabulous, and exuding a passionate energy. If you're in the mood for an unforgettable evening, seize this opportunity. And don’t forget to put your best foot forward in terms of your appearance!

taurus.horoscope: 今天，金牛座，你與家人和同住者的關係可能​​會閃閃發光。如果您碰巧在工作場所之外遇到同事，希望他們也能表現出友好和鼓勵。這種正面的氛圍可能來自於你們之間建立的清晰的溝通，從而導致你們之間產生新的理解。培養這種開放性；它將為所有相關方帶來好處。
taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, your connections with family and those you live with are likely to shine. If you happen to meet colleagues outside of the workplace, expect them to be friendly and encouraging as well. This positive vibe may arise from the clear communication you've established, leading to a fresh understanding among you. Nurture this openness; it will bring advantages to all parties involved.

gemini.horoscope: 今天，雙子座，你可能會發現自己正在與你的浪漫伴侶分享甜蜜的情感。最近幾週已經消除了阻礙公開對話的任何障礙，使你們倆更容易分享自己的情感。但要注意不要做得太過分；過於感性可能會讓你的伴侶不舒服。保持微妙並享受你們分享的時刻。
gemini.horoscope_en: Today, Gemini, you may find yourself sharing sweet sentiments with your romantic partner. Recent weeks have smoothed out any barriers that hindered open dialogue, making it easier for both of you to share your emotions. However, be mindful not to overdo it; being overly sentimental might not sit well with your partner. Keep it subtle and savor the moments you share.

cancer.horoscope: 巨蟹座，財務方面，你的情況正在好轉！今天可能是購買期待已久的生活空間的絕佳機會。無論是新家具、新油漆，甚至是新家，您都可能會在您的選擇中找到樂趣。不要忽視土地投資的潛力。無論您選擇哪種方式，它都有望顯著改善您的家庭環境。擁抱變化！
cancer.horoscope_en: Financially, things are looking up for you, Cancer! Today could be the perfect opportunity to indulge in a long-awaited purchase for your living space. Whether it's new furniture, a fresh coat of paint, or even a new home altogether, you're likely to find joy in your choices. Don't overlook the potential of investing in land as well. Whatever path you choose, it promises to enhance your home environment significantly. Embrace the changes!
cancer.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

leo.horoscope: 今天，獅子座，你可能會散發出難以抗拒的魅力和充滿活力的外表。期待來自朋友、鄰居，甚至那些你不熟悉的人的讚美。你們的談話將充滿溫暖和積極性，培養支持性的連結。你所有的關係都將加深。如果您今晚可以安排與伴侶的約會，您將獲得特別快樂和充實的體驗。充分利用你的一天！
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, you’re likely to shine with an irresistible charm and a vibrant appearance. Expect compliments from friends, neighbors, and even those you don’t know well. Your conversations will be filled with warmth and positivity, fostering supportive connections. All your relationships are set to deepen. If you can arrange a date with your partner this evening, you’re in for a particularly joyful and fulfilling experience. Make the most of your day!
leo.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

virgo.horoscope: 今天，處女座，你的創造力即將飆升，你的想像力已準備好起飛。你可能會在寫作、音樂或繪畫等藝術活動中遇到大量絕妙的想法。深入研究其中一個項目，並記下其餘項目以獲取未來的靈感。您可能還會注意到您的直覺有所增強，因此請擁抱這種增強的意識。享受過程，發揮你的創造力！
virgo.horoscope_en: Today, Virgo, your creativity is set to soar, and your imagination is ready to take flight. You may experience a surge of brilliant ideas for artistic endeavors like writing, music, or painting. Dive into one of these projects and jot down the rest for future inspiration. You might also notice a boost in your intuition, so embrace this heightened awareness. Enjoy the process and let your creativity shine!
virgo.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

libra.horoscope: 今天，天秤座，你可能會發現自己正在與一些多年未聯繫的朋友進行舒適的聚會。重聚會帶給你歡樂，也可能會遇到一些有趣的新面孔。留意可能會出現的有趣的花絮資訊。請小心，因為與您關係密切的人可能會感到情緒低落並可能尋求您的支持。總的來說，期待充滿幸福和滿足的一天。充分利用它！
libra.horoscope_en: Today, Libra, you might find yourself at a cozy gathering with a few friends you haven't connected with in ages. Reuniting will bring you joy, and you may also encounter some intriguing new faces. Keep an ear out for fascinating tidbits of information that could come your way. Be mindful, as someone close to you may be feeling down and could seek your support. Overall, expect a day filled with happiness and fulfillment. Make the most of it!
libra.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

scorpio.horoscope: 天蠍座，如果你一直在追求創意藝術事業，今天可能會為你帶來一些關於即將成功的令人興奮的消息！這對你來說是充滿滿足的一天。期待渴望慶祝您的成就的朋友們來電或來訪。您的腦海中可能充滿了新的專案想法。如果可以的話，今晚請自己與朋友或重要的其他人一起出去吃晚餐——這是你應得的！
scorpio.horoscope_en: Scorpio, if you've been chasing a career in the creative arts, today might bring you some exciting news about an impending success! It's a day filled with satisfaction for you. Expect calls or visits from friends eager to celebrate your achievements. Your mind may be buzzing with fresh project ideas. If you can, treat yourself to a dinner out with friends or your significant other tonight—you've earned it!
scorpio.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

sagittarius.horoscope: 今天，射手座，你可能會接到遠方朋友的電話或電子郵件。他們可能正在考慮去您所在的地區旅行，並渴望重新建立聯繫。這個消息可能會給你帶來快樂，儘管你最初可能會擔心工作承諾或其他緊迫的事情會妨礙你。只需一點計劃，您就可以實現它！請務必在日曆上圈出他們來訪的日期，並預見未來的美好時光。祝你有美好的一天！
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today, Sagittarius, you might receive a call or email from a distant friend. They could be considering a trip to your area and are eager to reconnect. This news is likely to bring you joy, though you may initially fret about work commitments or other pressing matters getting in the way. With a little planning, you can make it happen! Be sure to circle the date of their visit on your calendar and anticipate the good times ahead. Have a wonderful day!
sagittarius.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，如果你的工作場所有可靠的利潤分享計劃，或者你持有公司股份，那麼準備好迎接一些令人興奮的消息吧！這些股票的價值可能已經超出了所有人的預期，這絕對是一個值得慶祝的理由。聚集您的同事，共同紀念這項成就。浪漫的伴侶也可能會加入祝賀。這種正面的趨勢似乎會持續下去，誰知道呢？您可能正在成為百萬富翁的路上！
capricorn.horoscope_en: Capricorn, if your workplace features a solid profit-sharing plan or if you hold shares in your company, get ready for some exciting news! The value of those shares may have soared beyond all expectations, and it's definitely a reason to celebrate. Gather your colleagues and mark this achievement together. A romantic partner may also join in to offer their congratulations. This positive trend seems set to persist, and who knows? You could be on the path to becoming a millionaire!

aquarius.horoscope: 今天是浪漫的美好一天，水瓶座！你的伴侶散發著魅力，看起來精神抖擻。您可能會發現自己被講座所吸引，甚至計劃一起度過一個有趣的周末。你們之間的溝通管道暢通無阻，充滿了誠實、支持和感情。不要讓這個機會溜走——試著一起度過一些美好的時光。這可能會成為值得紀念的一天！
aquarius.horoscope_en: Today is a wonderful day for romance, Aquarius! Your partner is radiating charm and seems to be in high spirits. You might find yourselves drawn to a lecture or even planning a fun weekend escape together. The lines of communication are flowing freely between you, filled with honesty, support, and affection. Don’t let this opportunity slip away—try to spend some quality time together. This could turn out to be a memorable day!

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，你對財務的奉獻今天即將得到回報！與去年相比，預計您的收入、投資和財產價值將顯著增加。在浪漫方面，事情看起來很光明，儘管你在與伴侶同步你的計劃時可能會遇到一些挑戰。花點時間享受您的勞動成果並慶祝您的成就。
pisces.horoscope_en: Pisces, your dedication to your finances is about to pay off today! Expect to see a significant increase in your earnings, investments, and property values compared to last year. On the romantic front, things are looking bright, though you may encounter some challenges in syncing your plans with your partner. Take a moment to enjoy the fruits of your labor and celebrate your achievements.
